# Mahmood Sultan

> Portfolio of Mahmood Sultan — third-year TCS & CCIT student at the University of Toronto Mississauga (BA Double Major, expected Apr 2028), open to tech internships and co-ops.

Mahmood Sultan is a student developer and designer based in Toronto. This portfolio showcases selected case studies, background, and contact information.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Hero introduction to Mahmood Sultan.
- [About](/#about): Background, education, and experience.
- [Selected work](/#work): Case studies for My Code Club, UTM Makerspace Access (CCT204, 4-person team), and Turtle Island Charity, plus shorter projects including Toronto Firearm Incident Analysis (CCT416), the Calorie Tracking App, and 100-Level Platformer Game.
- [UTM Makerspace Access](/projects/campus-navigation): UX research case study on why immigrant ICCIT students avoided the Library Makerspace.
- [Contact](/#contact): Get in touch with Mahmood.
